positions.commentary: The speaker suggests that Amazon and Google are more easily regulated than consultancies, which would be squeezed by pricing H1B visas.
The speaker argues that if H1B visas are priced, Google would capture the vast majority of talent, leaving startups behind.
The speaker notes that Intel historically recruited from middle-of-the-country schools, unlike current big tech targets.
The speaker mentions that Meta pays engineers very high salaries, contrasting them with average IT engineers.
The speaker suggests Cisco might do something interesting in the future.
The speaker notes Oracle is making crazy moves and missed by the market.
The speaker predicts more scale from parts of the stack like Broadcom due to AI factories.
The speaker mentions Nvidia as a company people look at, but does not express a specific view.
